name: @niivue/zarrita-rs
description: Drop-in replacement for zarrita.js with Rust/WebAssembly chunk decoding in Web Workers

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../.. && RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+simd128,+bulk-memory" CFLAGS_wasm32_unknown_unknown="-msimd128 -mbulk-memory -O3" cargo build -p zarrita-rs --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/zarrita_rs.wasm packages/zarrita-rs/src/wasm/zarrita.wasm
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/wasm/assets.js src/wasm/assets.d.ts src/wasm/core.js src/wasm/core.d.ts src/wasm/copy.js src/wasm/copy.d.ts src/wasm/zarrita.wasm dist/wasm/ && bunx esbuild src/wasm/worker.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/wasm/worker.js --log-level=warning && node scripts/build-inline.mjs
